parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Data Warehouse Edition cluster.

> Call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~) operation to query the IDs of all Data Warehouse Edition clusters in a specific region.

parameters.name: GroupName
parameters.description:
The name of the resource group.

> Call the [DescribeDBResourceGroup](~~459446~~) operation to view the name of the resource group for a specific cluster.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.
